items.title: Introducing policy-based routing for AWS Transit Gateway
items.summary: Policy-based routing (PBR) for AWS Transit Gateway matches traffic on its 5-tuple (source and destination IP, source and destination port, and protocol) and sends each class to a different route table. This post explains how PBR works and walks through a reference architecture, console setup, and three use cases.
items.creator: Arshdeep Grover
